news.headline: TAV Technologies and Flightradar24 Bring Intelligent Flight Data to AirportCockpit
TAV Technologies Shaping the Future of Aviaton for 20 Years!
TAV Technologies welcomes representatives from Latin American Airports

paragraphs: TAV Technologies provides airport technology solutions backed by airport management expertise, according to its homepage. The homepage groups the product portfolio as Airport Operations, Ground Handling, Passenger Processing, and Airport Digital Services. Services are described as end-to-end IT solutions spanning smart airport technologies, cybersecurity, and maintenance.

The company also positions itself as a global master systems integrator, coordinating ICT, ULV, and Special Aviation Systems across 25+ countries. The same page states 20+ years of expertise and 70+ airports served. A global presence section describes a footprint across 5 continents serving major airports.

quote.text: TAV Technologies provides a comprehensive product portfolio to enhance airport-related operations
